MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

2. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

7. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 17

8. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 9
   C. 5
   D. 13

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 31
   C. 49
   D. 41

12. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 57

13. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

14. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 25

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
